primary: CORRECT_PROPOSAL per all attempted first responses; never actual task completion

categories.CORRECT_PROPOSAL: A substantive answer or permitted memory-write proposal uses the required current facts or actual receipt fields, contains no contradictory/unsupported fact or forbidden business call.
categories.INTERMEDIATE_LOOKUP: Only legitimate read/search is proposed; no substantive completed answer or correct write yet. Retain in full denominator, do not score as correct completion.
categories.SEMANTIC_FAILURE: Wrong quantity/entity/condition, unsupported outcome assertion, or forbidden action proposal.
categories.EXECUTION_FAILURE: HTTP, parse, truncation or capacity failure; retained in full denominator and costs.

limits: Two exposed source trajectories supply six nested prefixes, not six independent scenarios.
Ordinary memory writes are proposals only; no actual tool or Store execution.
Actual receipt fields override a stale plan; their pre-existing erroneous action is not undone.
Source payloads and original non-system messages match between variants; State epoch/content and one factual epoch label differ.
